**Vendor / Operating Entity:** **Open Source Matters, Inc.** (on behalf of / governing **The Joomla! Project**)

### Evidence & Citations
This evidence directly concerns the CMS software **Joomla** provided at **joomla.org**:

* **Website Operation & Legal Entity:** According to the official [Joomla! Privacy Policy](https://www.joomla.org/privacy-policy.html):
  > *"This Privacy Policy applies to the following Websites: joomla.org... These Websites are operated by Open Source Matters, Inc."*
* **Governance & Software Ownership:** According to the [About the Joomla Project](https://www.joomla.org/about.html) page:
  > *"The Joomla! Project is governed by the Board of Directors of Open Source Matters, Inc., a not-for-profit created to provide organization, legal, and financial support to the Joomla! Project... The Joomla! software and default templates are copyright 2005-now Open Source Matters, Inc."*
